streak_assessment: Not near the stop rule. exp-0089 (a cheap fixed 3-cp-per-square net-mobility term in _model_evaluate) was just promoted with a fast paired-arena score of 0.625, interval [0.522, 0.718], 14-12-6, zero reliability failures, ablation strength 0.625 with 28 divergent moves. Per the handoff the scientific non-improvement streak resets to 0 on promotion, and state.json records consecutive_non_improvements 0. The stop rule requires >=5 consecutive scientifically completed non-improvements since the newest promotion AND no materially new well-motivated experiment; neither half is met. Moreover the direction just changed: after twelve saturated search/ordering/quiescence/time candidates (exp-0076..exp-0088), leaf evaluation has now produced its first promotion in this window, so the richer-leaf-evaluation direction is freshly productive rather than saturated. Multiple adjacent cheap positional terms (king safety, passed pawns, bishop pair, rook-on-open-file) remain untested in the arena.
recurring_failure_modes: Non-forced threefold-repetition draws in balanced or better positions with piece shuffling: even in the exp-0089 arena that promoted the mobility term, ~12/32 games were drawn, almost all by threefold_repetition from roughly equal or better midd/endgame positions (e.g. the four-knights, nimzo-indian, petroff and scandinavian games). Mobility reduced but did not remove this.

Middlegame checkmates with an uncastled king: a large share of the 6/32 exp-0089 losses are mates between moves ~20 and ~45 after Phineas plays an early queen move (frequently Qe2) and Kd1/Ke2, never castles, and the king is hunted down (reti, sicilian, slav, caro-kann, alekhine games). The champion's only king feature is a flat castling-rights scalar that does not respond to actual attackers near the king.

Endgame conversion / winning-position drift: some games reach material-up or clearly better endgames that are then drawn by repetition or 50-move drift (e.g. the kings-indian game to move 70 and the dutch game to move 57), indicating the flat PSQT-plus-mobility leaf gives no gradient toward progress once material is stable.

Queen-safety in the opening: the trained model repeatedly walks the queen out early (Qe2/Qh5/Qa4) and sometimes loses it or spends many tempi retreating it, a symptom of no penalty for exposed high-value pieces.

next_direction.title: Non-linear king-danger term in the leaf evaluation
next_direction.hypothesis: Adding a cheap non-linear king-danger penalty to _model_evaluate reduces the recurring middlegame checkmate losses without retraining. During the existing per-piece loop in _model_evaluate, OR each piece's attacks_mask (including the kings') into one integer attack-bitboard per colour. After the loop, for each side compute d = chess.popcount(enemy_attack_bb & ring_bb) where ring_bb is the king's adjacent squares (chess.BB_KING_ATTACKS[board.king(colour)]), clamp d to a small cap, and add sign * -KS_WEIGHT * d * d to score. The quadratic shape gives alpha-beta a monotone, sharply increasing reason to keep its own king shielded and to press an attack on an exposed enemy king, which the flat castling-rights scalar cannot express.
next_direction.rationale: exp-0089's own retained arena shows 6/32 losses and a clear majority of them are mates around moves 20-45 with an uncastled king after an early queen sortie (reti, sicilian, slav, caro-kann, alekhine games). The champion has no attacker-aware king term at all, only WEIGHTS[CASTLING_OFFSET] as a static bonus. exp-0089 just demonstrated that a single cheap hand-scaled leaf term (mobility) can move the paired-arena score to 0.625 without touching the model. The only prior king-safety attempt was a six-feature LINEAR trained residual that had no offline signal and never reached the arena; a direct non-linear attacker-count penalty computed in agent.py is a materially different mechanism and is explicitly named as an open direction in the handoff. Reusing the attack masks already gathered for the mobility loop makes the added cost a handful of int-ORs and two popcounts per leaf.
next_direction.guardrails: Reuse the existing piece loop: accumulate attacks_mask into two Python ints, with no second legal-move generation and no per-leaf object allocation beyond those ints and the ring lookup. Use only documented python-chess API (board.king, chess.BB_KING_ATTACKS or board.attacks_mask, chess.popcount, chess.SquareSet); never read library internals or any path outside agent.py and weights/. Clamp d at roughly 6-8 and fix KS_WEIGHT near 2-3 centipawns so the worst-case penalty stays around 1-1.5 pawn and only in genuine mating attacks, while a typical position stays well under a third of a pawn and far below the model's ~118 cp RMSE, keeping the trained PSQT and the accepted mobility term dominant. Must hold model-ablation minimum_strength_score >= 0.625 with >= 8 divergent moves, and pass the full stress_time_left_ms grid (1/25/100/1000/120000) with required_failures 0; exp-0089's worst single move was 0.807 s against the 2.25 s ceiling at the 120 s clock and 0.042 s against 0.75 s at the 1 s clock, so the extra popcounts must keep leaf cost within roughly 1.3x. No change to _budget_seconds or the iterative-deepening loop. If the arena is inconclusive, do not merely retune KS_WEIGHT, the cap, or the ring definition: move to the next distinct positional term (passed pawns, then rook-on-open-file or bishop pair).

audit_summary: exp-0089 promoted a cheap fixed net-mobility term into the previously positionally blind tapered-PSQT leaf, scoring 0.625 (interval [0.522, 0.718], 14-12-6) with clean reliability and ablation, and reset the non-improvement streak to 0. The current champion (agent.py at 4a0c988) now has a mature PVS/LMR/TT search plus one mobility term, but its only king feature is a flat castling-rights scalar. The direction is not saturated: the twelve-candidate search/ordering/quiescence/time plateau (exp-0076..exp-0088) has been broken by a leaf-evaluation change, and several cheap positional terms remain untested in the arena. The dominant recurring failure modes in retained games are (1) non-forced threefold-repetition draws from balanced-or-better positions and (2) middlegame checkmates with an uncastled king after an early queen move. The next experiment adds a non-linear king-danger penalty to _model_evaluate, reusing the attack masks already gathered for the mobility loop, with a small hand-chosen quadratic coefficient and an attacker-count cap, keeping the trained model dominant. This is distinct from the exhausted six-feature linear king-safety residual (which had no offline signal and never reached the arena). If it does not help, passed pawns, rook-on-open-file, bishop pair, non-linear queen exposure, and ultimately an offline retrain with positional features remain before true scientific saturation. The protected champion is newer and better-supported than the live exp-0052-era upload, but uploading is out of scope.
